    METHOD

    What is measured and what is modelled

    Measured or publishedCommunity coordinates, provider, backhaul, small-cell sites and mapped facilities are imported from the listed public sources.

    Prototype modellingResilience scores, scenario impacts, deployment priorities and cyclone forecast geometry demonstrate the decision workflow and are clearly labelled indicative.

    Safety boundaryThis prototype is not an operational warning service. Users must confirm emergency information with the relevant authority.

    ABOUT

    RemoteReady NT

    RemoteReady NT combines public connectivity and facility locations with an indicative resilience model to help remote communities prepare for communications disruption.

    Design references

    • First Nations Connectivity Mapping Tool — layer organisation and location search.
    • Queensland disaster dashboards — warning hierarchy, situation summaries and resource visibility.
    • Bureau of Meteorology cyclone maps — observed versus forecast movement and uncertainty.
    • Saftera — offline preparation, saved device data and mobile field tools.

    Prototype only. Do not use this application as the sole source of emergency or navigation information.
